시편-147-1.title: 시편 147장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-1.exegesis: PSALM 146 Psa 146:1-10 . An exhortation to praise God, who, by the gracious and faithful exercise of His power in goodness to the needy, is alone worthy of implicit trust.
시편-147-1.theologicalNote: PSALM 146 Psa 146:1-10 . An exhortation to praise God, who, by the gracious and faithful exercise of His power in goodness to the needy, is alone worthy of implicit trust.

시편-147-2.title: 시편 147장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-2.exegesis: PSALM 147 Psa 147:1-20 . This and the remaining Psalms have been represented as specially designed to celebrate the rebuilding of Jerusalem (compare Ne 6:16 ; 12:27 ). They all open and close with the stirring call for praise. This one specially declares God's providential care towards all creatures, and particularly His people. 1. (Compare Psa 92:1 ; 135:3 ).
시편-147-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 147 Psa 147:1-20 . This and the remaining Psalms have been represented as specially designed to celebrate the rebuilding of Jerusalem (compare Ne 6:16 ; 12:27 ). 시편-147-5.title: 시편 147장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-5.exegesis: 4-5. God's power in nature ( Is 40:26-28 , and often) is presented as a pledge of His power to help His people. telleth ... stars-- what no man can do ( Ge 15:5 ).

시편-147-8.title: 시편 147장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-8.exegesis: 7-9. His providence supplies bountifully the wild animals in their mountain homes. Sing ... Lord-- literally, "Answer the Lord," that is, in grateful praise to His goodness, thus declared in His acts.

시편-147-11.title: 시편 147장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-11.exegesis: 10-11. The advantages afforded, as in war by the strength of the horse or the agility of man, do not incline God to favor any; but those who fear and, of course, trust Him, will obtain His approbation and aid.

시편-147-16.title: 시편 147장 16절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-16.exegesis: 15-18. God's Word, as a swift messenger, executes His purpose, for with Him to command is to perform ( Ge 1:3 ; Psa 33:9 ), and He brings about the wonders of providence as easily as men cast crumbs.

시편-147-20.title: 시편 147장 20절 역사문법적 주해
시편-147-20.exegesis: 19-20. This mighty ruler and benefactor of heaven and earth is such especially to His chosen people, to whom alone ( De 4:32-34 ) He has made known His will, while others have been left in darkness. Therefore unite in the great hallelujah.
